method.build_seconds: Wall clock around the builder subprocess (`phase5g_profile_sheets.py --synthetic`), process start to exit: imports, DuckDB queries over the three parquets, writing out every sentence, compressing and writing the store, hashing it for the stamp.
method.store_mb: Sum of the bytes of every store file (index, parts, stamp), MB = 10^6 bytes.
method.lookup: 1000 keys drawn uniformly (seed 14) from all sheet keys. Each in its own new Python process: import the reader, open the store (`verify()`: read the stamp, SHA-256 every file, load the index), then time `get(level, code)`, then `place(level, code)`, then `find(level, <its name>)` twice, each alone with perf_counter. The first find at a level builds that level's name map, so `find_first_ms` includes it and `find_ms` is a repeat. `open_ms` is the one-off open a service pays once at start, reported separately with no target (spec §8.1, D77). The OS file cache is warm after the first process (the store is read by each open's hash pass).
method.memory: psutil RSS in the same fresh process, against the RSS after importing the reader and before opening: `rss_open_mb` right after `verify()`; `rss_after_finds_mb` after one get, one place, and the first `find` at every one of the four levels (all four name maps built). Median, p95 and maximum over the lookup processes.
